title: hotfix: stabilize SLO enforcer backoff ordering during regional failovers
author: Asha Menon
description: Context: During a cross-region outage on 2026-02-26 we observed the SLO enforcer triggering aggressive backoff+circuit-breaker behavior in the regional failover path. Symptoms included ordering inversion in the backoff queue which caused a cascade of early long backoffs and unnecessary capacity blackholing. This PR stabilizes ordering semantics and tightens the backoff smoothing to avoid thrashing during rapid regional failover and re-open events. Root cause: the enforcer's backoff queue relied on wall-clock timestamps and non-deterministic map iteration when promoted entries were re-inserted which could reorder entries under high concurrency. Additionally the backoff smoothing window was reset on delayed acknowledgements, allowing successive inflight errors to amplify backoff. Changes: 1) Replace map-based promotion with a lock-free priority list with monotonic sequence ties to preserve FIFO among equal-priority entries. 2) Use monotonic clock for backoff scheduling to avoid wall-clock jumps. 3) Add smoothing hysteresis: backoff window now uses an EWMA with configurable alpha and a minimum hold time before increasing severity. 4) Hardened the regional failover path to prefer local warm-pool fallbacks for a configurable probation window to reduce full-circuit opens. 5) Add metrics and tracing: slo.enforcer.backoff_queue.depth, slo.enforcer.backoff_queue.reorder_count, slo.enforcer.backoff_smoothing. 6) Added targeted unit and integration tests that reproduce the high-concurrency promotion scenario and a small canary run against staging with injected region partitions. Testing and CI: Initial CI run failed due to a race in backoff_queue_test; fixed by introducing a stricter test harness and documented the invariant. After two CI reruns all checks passed (unit, integration, linters, e2e-canary). Rollout plan: squash-merge to main, staged rollout to release candidates and then to production via canary (10% -> 50% -> 100%) with a 15-minute observation window. If any SLO regressions occur revert via the automated rollback playbook linked in the Linear ticket. Related: ENG-1987 (stability), SUP-5421 (support incident).

review_comments: Diego Alvarez: I reproduced the ordering inversion locally with the provided test harness. The lock-free structure looks good but please add an explicit tie-breaker sequence so promotions are deterministic.
Asha Menon: Added monotonic sequence tie-breaker and expanded the test to assert strict ordering under concurrent promotions.
Maya Patel: We should be careful about the EWMA alpha default; recommend 0.25 to avoid being too reactive. Also add a feature flag for the probation window so we can tune without redeploy.
Asha Menon: Set alpha default to 0.25 and introduced slo_enforcer_probation_window feature flag; updated docs and helm values for staging.
Connor Li: CI flake on backoff_queue_test - race detected in test harness. After the harness fix the test is deterministic. Approving once CI passes.
Diego Alvarez: Approved and verified metrics are emitted (reorder_count shows 0 in the canary run).
release_notes: Hotfix: Stabilize SLO enforcer backoff ordering during regional failovers. Reduces false-positive circuit opens and backoff thrashing; adds metrics and a probation fallback to reduce failover side-effects. Includes a feature flag for tuning probation window.
notes: Backported small test harness change to release-2026.02 branch for fast rollback validation.
Monitoring: dashboards updated: SLO Enforcer -> Backoff Queue; alert thresholds tightened for reorder_count > 5/min.
